captions.detailed: A bicycle track pump featuring a tall, light-grey cylindrical barrel standing on a dark-grey tripod foot base. At the top of the barrel, a thin metallic rod extends vertically and is capped by a wide, black T-shaped handle. The handle and its attached piston rod are designed to slide vertically along the barrel axis in a prismatic motion.
captions.instruction: Create an articulated 3D model of a bicycle track pump. It should feature a stable tripod base, a tall vertical cylinder for the main pump body, and a T-handle connected to a thin piston rod that slides vertically relative to the body.
captions.factory: The model is constructed in two main parts. The base part (the pump body) is created by combining three extruded wedges arranged 120 degrees apart for the tripod feet with a vertical cylinder for the main barrel. The sliding part (the handle) consists of a thin cylinder for the piston rod, a vertical cylindrical connector, and a horizontal hexagonal prism for the T-handle grip. A prismatic articulation is defined between the base and the handle along the Z-axis.
